description: Client-side script for Purchase Receipt doctype in ERPNext, handling UI interactions, button actions, and form logic.

classes.name: PurchaseReceiptController
classes.description: Controller class extending BuyingController for Purchase Receipt, managing form refresh and actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the PurchaseReceiptController, including posting date/time checks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, updates buttons, ledger views, and status-based actions.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Invoice from the current Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: make_purchase_return
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Return from the current Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: close_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Updates the status of the Purchase Receipt to 'Closed'.

methods.name: reopen_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Reopens a closed Purchase Receipt, setting status to 'Submitted'.

methods.name: make_retention_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a retention stock entry related to the Purchase Receipt.
